title: The Watcher
description: A jaguar (Panthera onca) patrols from a tree beneath a star-filled sky in Brazil’s Pantanal region, home to the world’s highest concentration of wild jaguars. As apex predators, these jaguars help regulate populations of prey such as capybaras, caimans, and deer. But their habitat faces growing threats from climate-driven mega fires, which have burned vast portions of the wetland.
translated_description: 一只美洲豹（Panthera onca）在巴西潘塔纳尔地区繁星点点的夜空下从树上巡视，这里是世界上野生美洲豹密度最高的地区。作为顶级捕食者，这些美洲豹有助于调节水豚、凯门鳄和鹿等猎物种群的数量。但它们的栖息地正面临日益严重的气候引发的特大火灾威胁，这些火灾已烧毁了这片湿地的很大一部分。
